d.ko: 케플링은 작을지 몰라도, 그들의 왕국 건설 모험은 거대합니다! A World of Keflings에서 친구들과 함께 세상을 건설하세요! 자원을 수확하고, 로봇을 만들고, 용과 친구가 되고, 으스스한 마녀가 더욱 으스스해지도록 도와주세요. 2010년의 고전적인 도시 건설 모험을 업데이트한 것입니다.
d.en: Keflings may be small, but their kingdom-building adventures are gigantic! Build a world with your friends in A World of Keflings! Harvest resources, construct robots, befriend a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this update of the classic 2010 city-building adventure.
d.zh: Keflings may be small, but their kingdom-building adventures are gigantic! Build a world with your friends in A World of Keflings! Harvest resources, construct robots, befriend a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this update of the classic 2010 city-building adventure.

rv.t: 총평: 컨텐츠가 작고 분량도 10시간 미만이라 저는 비추 BUT 어린 자녀들의 힐링을 위한 선물용으로는 OK 하여튼 나쁘진 않았지만 99점이라는 영광의 타이틀을 얻을 정도까지는 아니었음.. …
i used to play this on my brothers old Xbox 360, id been searching for the game for a pretty long time and finally found it! i even bought all of the DLCs because i had that much fun playing it :')
That was my favorite childhood game on the Xbox 360. Thank you for the opportunity to experience that silly fairy tail again.
I very much adore A World of Keflings, I played it a lot on my Xbox 360 and if this was exactly the same game I'd be giving it 2 thumbs up, BUT the PC version crashes nonstop. …
说实话，我一直想玩这个来着，可惜这游戏之前没有pc端，现在也算圆梦了吧
这游戏在我小的时候抱过我.jpg 很有意思的小品游戏，14年的轻建造+轻资源规划，玩起来不是很费脑子，还是能找回之前的快乐。 除了画风粗糙和音乐少以外没啥缺点，毕竟是老游戏。
